title: First Missing Positive
prompt: Find the smallest missing positive integer in an unsorted array in O(n) time and constant extra space.
hints: Use the array itself to place numbers near their natural indices.
Ignore values that are not useful for the 1..n range.

title: Trapping Rain Water
prompt: Given non-negative integers representing elevation heights, compute how much water can be trapped after raining.
hints: Water at a position depends on the highest bar to the left and right.
A two-pointer approach can avoid extra arrays.
